description: This file implements the AdbConfig interface in the cuttlefish project, defining the AdbConfigImpl class with methods to manage ADB modes and connector state, and providing a component for dependency injection.

classes.name: AdbConfigImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfig interface managing ADB modes and connector state.

methods.name: Modes()
methods.description: Returns the current set of ADB modes.

methods.name: SetModes(std::set<AdbMode>&& modes)
methods.description: Sets the ADB modes using move semantics.

methods.name: RunConnector()
methods.description: Returns whether the connector should run.

methods.name: SetRunConnector(bool run)
methods.description: Sets whether the connector should run.
